typography.rules: Radical contrast. Never use Inter for headings. Use fluid scales. Do NOT center align by default.

data_and_numbers.style: Used for all dates, currency, progress percentages, and tabular numeric data to ensure tabular lining and a technical feel.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Neo-Glassmorphism. Floating panels must have backdrop-blur-2xl and a 1px solid inner border (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)). NO muddy gray transparency.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid full screen gradients. Use targeted 'glows' (radial gradients) behind key data points (e.g., a subtle 20% opacity green glow behind completed project stats).
visual_enhancers.textures: Overlay a subtle fixed noise/grain image on the root background to remove digital flatness.

layouts.general: Sidebar navigation (left, slim) + Top utility bar (search, profile, view toggle) + Main Content Area. Dense, compact padding for dashboard components (p-4 to p-6).
layouts.login_screen: Split screen layout. Left side: Abstract Cyberpunk image with a dark gradient overlay. Right side: Centered, minimal glassmorphic login form.
layouts.dashboard_home: High-density Bento Grid (Mode B). Top row: Summary widgets (Total Programmed, Meta vs Actual). Middle: Toggleable Project Matrix.
layouts.matrix_table_view: Dense border-collapse style. Headers are uppercase mono. Cells have subtle right/bottom borders (border-white/5). Rows hover with slightly lighter background.
layouts.matrix_timeline_view: Horizontal Gantt style. Projects represent glowing rounded-full or pill-shaped bars. Use framer-motion for drag/scroll if applicable.
layouts.spacing_scale: Use Tailwind p-4, p-6, p-8. Ensure internal padding prevents text from touching borders.

components_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp edges with 1px border. On hover, apply a subtle inner glow or background color shift. Avoid generic blue buttons.
components_instructions.view_toggle: A segmented control (pill shaped) using framer-motion layoutId for the active background indicator.
components_instructions.progress_bars: Do not use standard flat progress bars. Use glowing segmented bars or a neon gradient fill that changes color based on the actual vs meta ratio.
components_instructions.tags_badges: Used for Teams, Status, Priority. Style: bg-zinc-900 with 1px solid border matching the indicator color, and text in the same indicator color.
components_instructions.modals_drawers: Use for CRUD operations (Adding Projects/Teams). Must use intense backdrop-blur. Slide in from the right (Drawer) instead of a centered modal for a more 'pro-tool' feel.

motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Framer Motion: fade and slide up slightly (y: 10 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1).
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements must shift visually. Scale up slightly (scale: 1.02) or increase border opacity.
motion_and_interaction.data_updates: When values change (Meta Diária), animate the number counter (use framer-motion or a custom hook).

image_urls.description: Futuristic neon city, perfect for the dark/tech login screen background.
Vibrant geometric neon design, alternative for authentication screen.
Professional headshot for team member or logged-in user profile.
Professional headshot for female team member.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure neon text against #050505 meets 4.5:1 ratio. If using bright neon as background (like a pill), text MUST be #000000.
accessibility.focus: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white focus:outline-none for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion in all framer-motion configurations.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Create a highly distinctive, technical, and creative frontend.
Write .js and .jsx files. DO NOT USE .tsx.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds for headers, overlays, or dropdowns. ALWAYS use a dark color (e.g., bg-zinc-950/90) with backdrop-blur.
Use JetBrains Mono (or another monospace) for all numerical data (money, meta, percentages) in the matrix.
Build a robust toggle between 'Table/Grid View' and 'Timeline/Calendar View' for the projects matrix.
Implement the daily goal (Meta diária) calculation: Visual indicator showing if the actual progress aligns with the expected daily progress.
Color System for Projects: Visually merge Status (Active/Paused), Progress (On Track, Lagging), and Priority (High, Low) using the Neon indicator colors provided.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (alerts and notifications for CRUD).
NEVER use placeholder image URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, recharts, sonner, date-fns.
Create the specific views: Login, Dashboard (Summary), Project Matrix (Timeline & Table modes).
Implement basic CRUD state for Projects (Name, Team, Date, Programmed Value, Daily Goal, Status, Priority).
Implement basic CRUD state for Teams (Name, Members).
Use standard Tailwind grid and flexbox for layout, avoiding Shadcn component rigidness where a custom bento grid looks better.
Ensure the UI uses the dark theme colors specified. No light theme required as this is an elite 'Cyber-Dashboard'.
